title: Seeking Coolness
paragraphs: Oh? The rival focused his energy and transformed.
“Come on, Naofumi—Gaelion has transformed into a dragon with water and ice attributes. Ride on Gaelion and cool off. Just like a sleek, smooth body like that orca woman!”

For some reason, the rival transformed into a dragon with skin resembling the beast form of the big sister and was inviting Father. The chill emitted by the rival began to drift through the air, carried by the wind.
“Gaelion-chan is lying on his back, making a blatant invitation…”
“You can enjoy a passionate time that makes you forget the heat.”
Father, dizzy from the heat, was about to walk toward the rival.
I can’t let that happen!
“No, Father, you can’t!”
“But it’s so hot… Even though we’re cooling off in the shade, the hot wind is…”
It’s definitely too hot. Rather, it’s unbearably hot.
What’s the temperature like?
“Ah! If we use the Meteor Shield, it seems to block out the heat!”
“Alright, gather around Naofumi!”
“Understood!”
Ren and Itsuki called out, and we all gathered around Father.
“Wait! This is making it hotter!”
Indeed. In the end, Father had to activate the Meteor Shield periodically to block out the heat.
“What a waste of effort…”
“Agreed…”
“Seriously…”

In the midst of all this, two people stood there unnaturally unfazed by the heat. The big sister and the physician. It’s understandable that the big sister was using magic to keep cool, but the physician was completely composed, calmly surveying the area.
“That antlion-like monster over there… I’ve never seen it before. It might be a new species.”
“Oh… so we should defeat it and investigate?”
“Yes. It would strengthen the heroes, and since there seem to be plenty of them, it’s a good idea.”
The big sister and the physician were discussing their plan. They’re too energetic. Even I was starting to get exhausted.
“Nothing is working…”
I held Father’s hand to prevent him from approaching the rival.
“Ugh… it’s unbearably hot… Deserts really are scorching…”
Father mumbled, torn between whether to go or not.
“What are you doing? Naofumi, come and cool down with us.”
Before I realized it, Itsuki and Ren had already pressed themselves against the rival and started cooling off. Even the big sister and her friend were already sticking to the rival.
“So cool…”
“I feel alive again.”
“What!? No! Gaelion transformed for Naofumi’s sake! Get off! Don’t try to steal Naofumi away in front of Filo and the Spear Hero!”
“And stealing Naofumi like that? That’s quite an imagination.”
“True. I mean, Naofumi, who’s been with Sadina, could probably handle anything.”
“As long as it’s a hole, huh?”
“What are you saying, Ren, Itsuki!? And why are you all cooling off like this!?”
“No! I have no choice! Ice Breath!”
With a whoosh, the rival unleashed a blizzard-like breath, freezing everything around us. Well, that too melted shortly after, though. Everyone was on the verge of being frozen solid.
“Cool… more…”
“Hot… it’s still too hot…”
“Ah… I’ve never been more grateful for a freezing breath like this.”
“True. Magic drains energy no matter what, so this is better.”
“Gaelion is getting hot! Naofumi! Please notice Gaelion’s efforts! He wants a virgin! Cool off by embracing Gaelion while doing something passionate!”
“He seemed so devoted, but that last line ruined it!”
Father’s pained cry echoed across the area.
Indeed… I have an idea.
“In that case, I will use fire magic here.”
“Someone kill Motoyasu!”
“Yeah, I’ll finish him off without hesitation!”

Ren and Itsuki directed enough killing intent at me to drop the surrounding temperature. Despite that, the big sister, her friend, and Filo all seemed to be enjoying the cool air. Their faces looked quite pleased. You could feel their desire to cool down, even if only a little. Still, the temperature was too high. Even the deserts I visited during my travels overseas weren’t this hot.
“Whoa… some of the sand has turned to glass…”
“That’s quite an intense heat.”
“So, Motoyasu… are you planning to kill us with that fire magic?”
Even Father was looking at me with a slightly murderous gaze. If you look at me like that, I’ll be troubled.
“Father, magic is a profound thing. Fire magic isn’t just for burning. There’s also a lineage of magic that deals with heat itself.”
“Wait, like in manga? The type that absorbs heat?”
“Exactly. I’ll cast fire magic that absorbs the surrounding heat and cools things down.”
“Whoa… is that really possible? Alright then, Motoyasu, go ahead. I’m counting on you.”
“Yeah.”
“Ren, please maintain your ice magic.”
“Ugh… got it. If it’s to stay cool, I’ll do whatever it takes!”

Is this a volcano or something? Thinking that, I cast fire magic to lower the temperature. After that, everyone kept using magic on each other while we waited for the sun to set and resumed our exploration. ---
“We’ve already used up quite a bit of magic and SP. Are we going to be okay?”
“Hmm… it’s tougher than I thought… and we’re going through water fast too…”
“So, are we moving forward? Or going back?”
“That’s the real question… I mean, that red city… it feels closer, but it’s still far away.”
“Maybe we should even consider stopping the adventure for now.”
“Yeah, maybe.”
Even I was feeling it. Even if we made it to the Prado Desert, if getting back was going to be difficult, we wouldn’t be able to stay here too long.
“For now, Gaelion, Rifana, and Raphtalia should search for a gap in the space… and do it as quickly as possible. Honestly, this place feels more like a volcanic zone than a desert.”
“Understood!”
“I’ll find it this time too. Right, Raphtalia?”
“Yeah!”
The big sisters nodded to each other, but Filolials and the others weren’t about to lose! Yuki and the others were also doing their best to break through the barrier this time.
“In the meantime, we’ll drink the magic water and spirit-healing water we have stored in our weapons to restore our magic and SP.”
“And yet, you’re just gulping it down like it’s a drink.”
Father looked exasperated. Well, it’s good to be fully prepared, but maybe they’re drinking a little too much. As we moved along, the big sister’s friend pointed at something.
“There it is!”
“Whoa! You found it?”
“Considering how cramped the place is with those antlion pits and the fact that the sun was about to rise again, this is a relief.”
“Ah, finally… we can go home.”

At that moment, the rival and the big sisters, who had been working on destroying the barrier, furrowed their brows. The Filolials were also breaking through from another point, but their reactions were the same. A very small hole had appeared.
“What’s this?”
“What?”
“What’s wrong?”
“When we try to break it, the hole closes up. We can only open it a little.”
And… the rival held out her hand toward the hole.
“This is… something trying to reinforce the space from the other side.”
What does that mean? Is there some kind of machine generating a barrier to confuse intruders?
“Should we search elsewhere?”
“That’s one option.”
“What’s it look like?”
The big sister’s friend peeked into the small gap the rival had managed to pry open. Since it was tiny, she had transformed into her weasel form.
“Ah, I see some kind of magic device ahead. Maybe that’s what’s blocking it?”
“That’s possible.”
“Hmm… could we do something with Gaelion and the others’ help?”
“It’s not quite the kind of thing you can deal with brute force.”
“Hmph! Such a hole… I’ll destroy it in one blow with my power!”
“Oh, that’s the spirit! Do it, Motoyasu! We need to get out before sunrise!”
“Yeah, I’d rather not stay in this blazing desert any longer.”

I thrust my spear into the small opening and fired off a shot from Brionac. But the hole showed no signs of widening. I peeked through the hole with my right eye, but aiming was incredibly difficult. I couldn’t see as well as the big sister’s friend.
“This is frustrating.”
“Totally useless.”
“Agreed.”
“Hmm…”
